tests.name: matches native SLN demux for -f sln and undeclared .sln inputs of six lengths through framecrc copy and decode WAV raw AIFF and output -ss -t -frames:a
refuses SLN inputs that native accepts: -ar -ac input -ss partial trailing samples and undeclared inputs under four bytes with no output created
opens the whole input as pcm_s16le 8000 Hz mono with no header read and bounded packet reads
refuses partial trailing samples input seeks invalid budgets and aborted opens
registers SLN as a demux-only extension-only format with no header bytes and the default packet span
copies SLN to raw s16le and refuses -ar -ac -sample_rate -ch_layout input -ss partial samples and SLN output before opening an output

details: 250 byte-exact outputs: lengths 0/1/511/512/513/3000 samples x -f sln (.dat) and undeclared .sln (lengths >= 2 samples) x 5 time profiles (none, output -ss 0.02, -t 0.05, -frames:a 2, -ss 0.0125 -t 0.2) x framecrc copy, framecrc pcm_s16le, WAV, raw s16le, AIFF; 50 batched native calls
100 native framecrc headers asserted as 1/8000 pcm_s16le 8000 Hz mono (detection parity), plus 3000-sample copy rows 512x5+440
1 native -f sln -ar 16000 probe: 16000 Hz, 1024-sample packets (reason input -ar is refused)

10 native-accepted inputs Edge refuses with no output: -ar 16000, -ac 2, undeclared -ar 8000, input -ss (declared and undeclared), odd byte count, undeclared 2-byte and empty .sln, -sample_rate 16000, -ch_layout stereo
1 -f sln output refused on both sides

unsupported: input -ar/-ac (native honours them; descriptor is not headerless so the PCM path refuses)
input -ss > 0 (refused in open until native timestamps are probed and mirrored)
partial trailing sample (native drops it with a decode error and exits 0)
undeclared .sln shorter than 4 bytes (detection needs 4 bytes; native accepts)

proposedContracts.name: matches native SLN demux for -f sln and undeclared .sln inputs of six lengths through framecrc copy and decode WAV raw AIFF and output -ss -t -frames:a
proposedContracts.scope: pcm_s16le 8000 Hz mono SLN demux, -f sln and undeclared .sln, 0-3000 samples, framecrc copy/decode, WAV, raw s16le, AIFF, output -ss/-t/-frames:a; 512-sample packets.

proposedContracts.name: refuses SLN inputs that native accepts: -ar -ac input -ss partial trailing samples and undeclared inputs under four bytes with no output created
proposedContracts.scope: Native-accepted -ar/-ac, -sample_rate/-ch_layout, input -ss, odd byte counts, undeclared inputs under 4 bytes and SLN output refused before Edge output creation.

notes: Native has no read_probe; demux.extensions ['.sln'] is used. Every undeclared native framecrc header was checked before comparing.
Not headerless by design: input -ar/-ac stay refused by the existing PCM-path check.
Sandbox Node was v22.23.5; /opt/node24 (v24.22.3) was used for bootstrap and all checks.
Setup durations: bootstrap (npm 9.2s, submodule 11.6s, reference build) 3m51s total; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests 1m16s.
Differential file runs in about 3 s on 4 vCPUs; no linux-gated cases.
No shared edits beyond the registry line were needed.
